definitions.explanation: Indicates exclusion of what precedes it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧{以外|いがい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{働|はたら}いています→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work every day except Sunday.

examples.japanese: これ{以外|いがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's no method other than this.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧{以外|いがい}⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いなかった→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There was no one besides me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧{以外|いがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外国語|がいこくご}→外国語：03023_gaikokugo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}した→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Have you ever studied a foreign language other than English?

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧{以外|いがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{話|はな}さない→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{実|じつ}は→実は：02524_jitsuha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいた→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I don't really tell people besides my family, but I actually lived overseas as a child.

notes:
{以外|いがい} means 'other than' or 'except.'

Grammar patterns:
- [noun]{以外|いがい}: other than [noun]
- [noun]{以外|いがい}に: besides [noun], other than [noun]
- [noun]{以外|いがい}の[noun]: [noun] other than ~

Note: Unlike English, {以外|いがい} comes AFTER the thing being excluded.

Similar expressions:
- 〜{以外|いがい} vs. 〜の{他|ほか}に: Both mean 'besides,' but {以外|いがい} emphasizes exclusion, while {他|ほか}に focuses on addition.
- 〜を{除|のぞ}いて: more formal way to say 'except'
